theorems.statement: ∀ (N k : ℕ) (M : ℕ → Set (Eucl N)) (θ : ℕ → Eucl N → ℝ) (ξ : ℕ → Eucl N → NVector (Eucl N) k), (∀ p, IsRectifiableTriple (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k (M p) (θ p) (ξ p)) → (∀ p, ∀ x ∈ M p, ∃ m : ℕ, θ p x = m) → (∑' p, ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (∑ γ : SimonMultiIndex k N, (euclideanNVectorCoordinate ((M (p + 1)).indicator (fun y => θ (p + 1) y • ξ (p + 1) y) x - (M p).indicator (fun y => θ p y • ξ p y) x) γ) ^ 2)) ∂(μHE[k] : Measure (Eucl N))) ≠ ∞ → ∃ (M₀ : Set (Eucl N)) (θ₀ : Eucl N → ℝ) (ξ₀ : Eucl N → NVector (Eucl N) k), IsRectifiableTriple (univ : Set (Eucl N)) k M₀ θ₀ ξ₀ ∧ (∀ x ∈ M₀, ∃ m : ℕ, θ₀ x = m) ∧ ∀ ω : Eucl N → Covector (Eucl N) k, Continuous ω → HasCompactSupport ω → Tendsto (fun p => tauAction k (M p) (θ p) (ξ p) ω) atTop (𝓝 (tauAction k M₀ θ₀ ξ₀ ω))
